title: KILLA – Mango Ice
description:
Killa Dry Mango Ice –feel the flavour of the Mango Ice and the unparalleled aftertaste.

Killa Dry Mango Ice is guaranteed to give you an unforgettable tropical experience, icy passion and a long, dry aftertaste.

You’re going to love it

Portion size: 0,7g
Nicotine: 16mg/1gram
Nicotine per portion: 11.2mg
Portions per can: 20 pc.
